It is traditionally held that to see Silphsela floating in the air heralds an imminent change in the sky.

Location: Duviri
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.descriptionZh:
传统上认为，看到日精灵瘦果漂浮在空中预示着天空即将发生变化。

获取地点：双衍王境

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.name: Dracroot
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.description:
Dracroot is a staple of the Wyrmling’s diet.

Location: Duviri
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.descriptionEn:
Dracroot is a staple of the Wyrmling’s diet.

Location: Duviri
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.descriptionZh:
龙旋根是魇龙幼体的主食。

获取地点：双衍王境

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.name: Ueymag
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.description:
Ueymag meat is said to be delicious. Just mind the barbs.

Location: Duviri
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.descriptionEn:
Ueymag meat is said to be delicious. Just mind the barbs.

Location: Duviri
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.descriptionZh:
据说肉麦的肉很好吃。但需小心其倒刺。

获取地点：双衍王境

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.name: Saggen Pearl
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.description:
Thrax warriors use the heavy liquid drawn from Saggen Wells to polish their weapons.

Location: Duviri
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.descriptionEn:
Thrax warriors use the heavy liquid drawn from Saggen Wells to polish their weapons.

Location: Duviri
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.descriptionZh:
士魂大帝的战士们使用从慧珠之泉提取出来的重质液体来擦拭他们的武器。

获取地点：双衍王境

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.name: Enigma Gyrum
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.description:
A token celebrating the successful solution of a Duviri Enigma.

Location: Earned by completing Enigmas in The Duviri Experience
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.descriptionEn:
A token celebrating the successful solution of a Duviri Enigma.

Location: Earned by completing Enigmas in The Duviri Experience
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.descriptionZh:
庆祝成功破解双衍王境奥理的纪念物。

获取地点：在双衍历程中完成奥理

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.name: Aggristone
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.description:
It is said that Aggri Formations are hardened saliva from mighty Orowyrms. Duviri citizens believe Aggristones are powerful talismans.

Location: Duviri
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.descriptionEn:
It is said that Aggri Formations are hardened saliva from mighty Orowyrms. Duviri citizens believe Aggristones are powerful talismans.

Location: Duviri
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Du.descriptionZh:
据说龙涎结晶是来自强大奥金魇龙的硬化唾液。双衍居民们相信龙涎石是强大的护身符。

获取地点：双衍王境

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.name: Inaak
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.description: Some theorize that Duviri stands upon the shell of a giant Inaak. Naturally, some wonder what the giant Inaak stands upon. The answer, of course, is other Inaaks, all the way down.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.descriptionEn: Some theorize that Duviri stands upon the shell of a giant Inaak. Naturally, some wonder what the giant Inaak stands upon. The answer, of course, is other Inaaks, all the way down.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.descriptionZh: 有些理论认为，双衍王境坐落在一只巨大的载世龟壳上。自然而然地，一些人会想知道巨大的载世龟是站在什么之上的。答案当然是其他载世龟，一个接一个叠到底部。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.name: Xiran
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.description: The Golden Maw finds Xirans exceptionally delicious.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.descriptionEn: The Golden Maw finds Xirans exceptionally delicious.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.descriptionZh: 黄金喉兽发现息壤鲳特别美味。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.name: Haav
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.description: Haav prefer to swim near the surface. Duviri citizens often mistake them for logs, which can be startling when Haav show their fangs.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.descriptionEn: Haav prefer to swim near the surface. Duviri citizens often mistake them for logs, which can be startling when Haav show their fangs.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.descriptionZh: 浮伤鱼喜欢在靠近水面的地方游。双衍王境的公民经常把它们误认为木头，当浮伤鱼露出它们的尖牙时，可能会让人大吃一惊。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.name: Namaes
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.description: The Namaes has evolved the ability to tense its tail muscles and use its tail as a fearsome weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.descriptionEn: The Namaes has evolved the ability to tense its tail muscles and use its tail as a fearsome weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.descriptionZh: 纳土鲉已经进化出收紧尾部肌肉的能力，并把它的尾巴当成一种可怕的武器。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.name: Seonn
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.description: The Seonn's ability to flare its neck and hood makes it impossible for most predators to swallow, but the Golden Maw can overcome its defense.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.descriptionEn: The Seonn's ability to flare its neck and hood makes it impossible for most predators to swallow, but the Golden Maw can overcome its defense.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.descriptionZh: 精灵鱼的颈部和头鳍可以伸展，让大多数的捕食者无法吞咽，但是黄金喉兽可以攻克它的防御。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.name: Nacreous Pebble
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.description:
Collectors like to marvel at the peculiar origin of Nacreous Pebbles. Their beauty is the result of ordinary pebbles having been ingested and regurgitated by the Golden Maw.

Location: Maw Feeding in The Duviri Experience
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.descriptionEn:
Collectors like to marvel at the peculiar origin of Nacreous Pebbles. Their beauty is the result of ordinary pebbles having been ingested and regurgitated by the Golden Maw.

Location: Maw Feeding in The Duviri Experience
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.descriptionZh:
收藏家们喜欢惊叹于珍珠母石的特殊来源。它们的美丽是普通鹅卵石被黄金喉兽吞食和反刍的结果。

获取地点：在双衍历程中喂食喉兽

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.name: Ariette Scale
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.description:
Each Duviri fish species has distinct features, but they all evolved beautiful chromatic scales.

Location: Maw Feeding in The Duviri Experience
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.descriptionEn:
Each Duviri fish species has distinct features, but they all evolved beautiful chromatic scales.

Location: Maw Feeding in The Duviri Experience
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.descriptionZh:
每一种双衍王境鱼类都具有与众不同的特征，但它们都进化产生了美丽的彩色鳞片。

获取地点：在双衍历程中喂食喉兽

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.name: Maw Fang
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.description:
Looks like someone got carried away during a delicious meal.

Location: Maw Feeding in The Duviri Experience
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.descriptionEn:
Looks like someone got carried away during a delicious meal.

Location: Maw Feeding in The Duviri Experience
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Duviri/Resource/Fi.descriptionZh:
看起来有人在一顿美餐中被冲昏了头脑。

获取地点：在双衍历程中喂食喉兽

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/DuviriMITW/Resourc.name: Temporal Dust
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/DuviriMITW/Resourc.description:
The dust of decayed universes, rich in entropy. Entrati's research postulates it as the animating agent of the nightmarish Murmur.

Obtained from Murmur in Isleweaver missions (Duviri)
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/DuviriMITW/Resourc.descriptionEn:
The dust of decayed universes, rich in entropy. Entrati's research postulates it as the animating agent of the nightmarish Murmur.

Obtained from Murmur in Isleweaver missions (Duviri)
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/DuviriMITW/Resourc.descriptionZh:
衰变宇宙的尘埃，富含熵。英择谛的研究推测，它正是如噩梦一般的低语者的驱动力。

在《织屿人》任务（双衍王境）中从低语者处获得

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/DuviriMITW/Resourc.name: Scuttler Husk
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/DuviriMITW/Resourc.description:
A remnant of battle with Oraxia, the spider that once wore this skin is gone… though it is not easy to tell where.

Obtained by defeating Oraxia in Isleweaver missions (Duviri)
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/DuviriMITW/Resourc.descriptionEn:
A remnant of battle with Oraxia, the spider that once wore this skin is gone… though it is not easy to tell where.

Obtained by defeating Oraxia in Isleweaver missions (Duviri)
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/DuviriMITW/Resourc.descriptionZh:
与 Oraxia 战斗留下的残骸，曾经穿着这外壳的蜘蛛已经不见了……然而它的去向不得而知。

在《织屿人》任务（双衍王境）中击败 Oraxia 获得

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/DuviriMITW/Resourc.name: Dominus Aureus
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/DuviriMITW/Resourc.description:
Stolen golden seals emblematic of royal authority in Duviri. Return them to restore Dominus Thrax to the throne.

Obtained by completing Isleweaver missions in Duviri during Operation: Eight Claw
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/DuviriMITW/Resourc.descriptionEn:
Stolen golden seals emblematic of royal authority in Duviri. Return them to restore Dominus Thrax to the throne.

Obtained by completing Isleweaver missions in Duviri during Operation: Eight Claw
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/DuviriMITW/Resourc.descriptionZh:
被盗的金印，象征双衍王境的王权。归还它们，让士魂大帝重回王位。

可通过在《行动代号：八爪》期间完成双衍王境的《织屿人》任务获得

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.name: Condroc Wing
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.description:
The talon on a condroc's wing is sharp enough to tear through bone.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.descriptionEn:
The talon on a condroc's wing is sharp enough to tear through bone.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.descriptionZh:
秃鹰翅膀上的利爪可以伤至见骨。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.name: Cetus Wisp
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.description:
Most common at night, these stone lifeforms are drawn to shorelines touched by the Eidolon. They linger around lakes on the Plains of Eidolon at all hours. Their origin remains mysterious.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.descriptionEn:
Most common at night, these stone lifeforms are drawn to shorelines touched by the Eidolon. They linger around lakes on the Plains of Eidolon at all hours. Their origin remains mysterious.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.descriptionZh:
这些最常出没于夜晚的岩石生命体会被夜灵所触及的海岸线所吸引。它们随时都在夜灵平野的湖泊周围徘徊。它们的起源仍然是个谜。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.name: Maprico
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.description:
This hardy fruit is thick-skinned to withstand harsh conditions, concealing a mouthful of sweet pulp within.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.descriptionEn:
This hardy fruit is thick-skinned to withstand harsh conditions, concealing a mouthful of sweet pulp within.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.descriptionZh:
这种顽强的植物有着坚硬的外皮以抵抗严峻的环境，将饱满的甜美果肉隐藏在其中。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.name: Kuaka Spinal Claw
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.description:
The sinew from the Kuaka's spinal claws can be tanned to make resilient and flexible leather.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.descriptionEn:
The sinew from the Kuaka's spinal claws can be tanned to make resilient and flexible leather.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.descriptionZh:
从库阿卡的脊爪上取得的肌腱，可以晒制成既强韧且具弹性的皮革。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.name: Grokdrul
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.description:
A noxious mix of polysaccharides and long-chain polymers, Grokdrul is a standard chemical used in Grineer manufacturing.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.descriptionEn:
A noxious mix of polysaccharides and long-chain polymers, Grokdrul is a standard chemical used in Grineer manufacturing.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.descriptionZh:
多醣类与长链聚合物的有毒混合物，葛克度是标准的 Grineer 工业化学材料。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.name: Iradite
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.description:
A mineral valuable to the Ostrons.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.descriptionEn:
A mineral valuable to the Ostrons.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.descriptionZh:
一种对 Ostron 人很有价值的矿物。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.name: Nistlepod
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.description:
Used by the Nistlebrush to trap and kill prey.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.descriptionEn:
Used by the Nistlebrush to trap and kill prey.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Eidolon/Resources/.descriptionZh:
尼蒐丛用它来困住并杀死猎物。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.name: Curse of Knowing
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.description:
This curse contains knowledge that will help Fibonacci prevent enemies from breaking free of The Sanctum. Feed curses to the Jahu Gargoyle in your Clan Dojo to re-calibrate its defensive capabilities.

Location: Effervo (Deimos) during Operation Gargoyle's Cry
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.descriptionEn:
This curse contains knowledge that will help Fibonacci prevent enemies from breaking free of The Sanctum. Feed curses to the Jahu Gargoyle in your Clan Dojo to re-calibrate its defensive capabilities.

Location: Effervo (Deimos) during Operation Gargoyle's Cry
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.descriptionZh:
这个诅咒包含了能帮助斐波那契阻止敌人逃离圣所的知识。将诅咒交给你们氏族道场的形态合成兽像，以重新调整其防御能力。

获取地点：《合成兽像的悲鸣》行动期间的恶涌（火卫二）

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.name: Curse of Hearing
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.description:
This curse contains knowledge that will help Fibonacci prevent enemies from breaking free of The Sanctum. Feed curses to the Jahu Gargoyle in your Clan Dojo to re-calibrate its defensive capabilities.

获取地点：《合成兽像的悲鸣》行动期间的恶涌（火卫二）

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.name: Curse of Seeing
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.description:

This curse contains knowledge that will help Fibonacci prevent enemies from breaking free of The Sanctum. Feed curses to the Jahu Gargoyle in your Clan Dojo to re-calibrate its defensive capabilities.

获取地点：《合成兽像的悲鸣》行动期间的恶涌（火卫二）

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.name: Grotesque Splinter
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.description:
A foreboding fragment of the vast Indifference.

Location: Effervo (Deimos) during Operation Gargoyle's Cry
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.descriptionEn:
A foreboding fragment of the vast Indifference.

Location: Effervo (Deimos) during Operation Gargoyle's Cry
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.descriptionZh:
巨大虚空无情之物的不祥碎片。

地点：《合成兽像的悲鸣》行动期间的恶涌（火卫二）

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.name: Entrati Obols
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.description:
During the Orokin era, these obols were a commonly recognized mark of the Entrati family. Some Archimedeans even used them as good luck talismans.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.descriptionEn:
During the Orokin era, these obols were a commonly recognized mark of the Entrati family. Some Archimedeans even used them as good luck talismans.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.descriptionZh:
在奥罗金时代，这些小硬币是英择谛家族公认的标志。一些哲士甚至把它们当作幸运护身符。

获取地点：阿尔布雷希特的实验室（火卫二）

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.name: Necracoil
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.description:
This experimental array transmutes Void energy into high voltages with low currents.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.descriptionEn:
This experimental array transmutes Void energy into high voltages with low currents.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.descriptionZh:
这个实验阵列将虚空能量转化为带有低电流的高电压。

获取地点：阿尔布雷希特的实验室（火卫二）

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.name: Stela
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.description:
This Void-touched stone contains an ominous essence.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.descriptionEn:
This Void-touched stone contains an ominous essence.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/EntratiLab/Resourc.descriptionZh:
这块虚空之石蕴含着不祥的本质。

获取地点：阿尔布雷希特的实验室（火卫二）

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.name: Scintillant
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.description:
These scarce, hovering relics of the Orokin era can still be found monitoring the isolation vaults deep beneath the surface of Deimos.

Location: Cambion Drift on Deimos
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.descriptionEn:
These scarce, hovering relics of the Orokin era can still be found monitoring the isolation vaults deep beneath the surface of Deimos.

Location: Cambion Drift on Deimos
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.descriptionZh:
这些罕见的奥罗金时代的悬浮遗迹，仍旧监视着火卫二地底深处的隔离库。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.name: Pustulite
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.description:
Half-formed, incomplete spore bearers, little more than twitching flesh with claws to latch on with.

Location: Cambion Drift on Deimos
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.descriptionEn:
Half-formed, incomplete spore bearers, little more than twitching flesh with claws to latch on with.

Location: Cambion Drift on Deimos
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.descriptionZh:
半成型的不完整孢子载体，只是一个会用利爪固定自己的抽搐着的肉块。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.name: Ganglion
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.description:
A fallen clump of entangled nerve fibers, redundant organs, and thin sensory membranes.

Location: Cambion Drift on Deimos
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/InfestedMicroplane.descriptionEn:
A fallen clump of entangled nerve fibers, redundant organs, and thin sensory membranes.

A device of undetermined function and origin. Prized by Vox Solaris and the Quills.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Co.name: Thermal Sludge
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Co.description:

Location: Orb Vallis on Venus

A by-product from the Weeping Towers terraforming processes.

Location: Orb Vallis on Venus

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Co.name: Gyromag Systems
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Co.description:
A modular component that regulates latitude and altitude in various Corpus systems. 

Location: Obtained by completing Heists on the Orb Vallis (Venus)
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Co.descriptionEn:
A modular component that regulates latitude and altitude in various Corpus systems.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Co.name: Atmo Systems
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Co.description:
A modular component that compensates for the multitude of atmospheric conditions encountered in the Origin System. 

Location: Obtained by completing Heists on the Orb Vallis (Venus)

A modular component that compensates for the multitude of atmospheric conditions encountered in the Origin System.

获取地点：可以通过完成奥布山谷（金星）的抢劫任务获得

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Co.name: Repeller Systems

获取地点：可以通过完成奥布山谷（金星）的抢劫任务获得。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Fu.name: Mytocardia Spore
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Fu.description:

A fungal body prized for its varied uses.

Location: Orb Vallis on Venus

获取地点：奥布山谷（金星）

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Or.name: Orokin Monitor
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Or.description: These Orokin devices emerge when the floating glaciers impact on the surface of Venus. Their purpose is unknown.

The reproductive spore of the giant Vallis fungi is highly coveted for the complex chemical compounds it contains.

获取地点：奥布山谷（金星）

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Ve.description: Engineered by the Orokin to convert airborne chemicals into breathable air.

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Venus/Resources/Ve.descriptionZh: 由奥罗金设计将大气中的化学物质转化为可呼吸的空气。

The iridescent nodules on these plants glow brightly in cold environments.

获取地点：奥布山谷（金星）

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/Zariman/Resources/.name: Lua Thrax Plasm

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.name: Ferment Bladder
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.description:
Many Deimos fish secrete reagents in a pouchlike organ, creating volatile gases that enable limited periods of levitation. 

Source: Cut from the following Cambion Drift fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos):
Ostimyr
Aquapulmo
Vitreospina
Cryptosuctus
Barbisteo
Kymaeros
Amniophysi
Glutinox
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.descriptionEn:
Many Deimos fish secrete reagents in a pouchlike organ, creating volatile gases that enable limited periods of levitation. 

Source: Cut from the following Cambion Drift fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos):
Ostimyr
Aquapulmo
Vitreospina
Cryptosuctus
Barbisteo
Kymaeros
Amniophysi
Glutinox
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.descriptionZh:
许多火卫二的鱼类会在类似囊状的器官中分泌液体来产生挥发性气体，从而实现短暂的悬浮。

来源：通过在殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'处分解以下魔胎之境的鱼类获得：
奥斯蒂剑鱼
水肺
璃化脊鳎
墓沼隐龙
倒刺蒂鳌
高额异鳍
针刺长鳄
狍鸮胶蛳

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.name: Tubercular Gill System
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.description:
Adaptive membranes allow many Deimos fish to move freely between fluid and gaseous environments.

Source: Cut from the following Cambion Drift fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos):
Ostimyr
Aquapulmo
Vitreospina
Myxostomata
Duroid
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.descriptionEn:
Adaptive membranes allow many Deimos fish to move freely between fluid and gaseous environments.

Source: Cut from the following Cambion Drift fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos):
Ostimyr
Aquapulmo
Vitreospina
Myxostomata
Duroid
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.descriptionZh:
自适应膜可使许多火卫二的鱼类在液体和气体环境之间自由移动。

来源：在殁世幽都（火卫二）中的'女儿'处分解以下魔胎之境的鱼类获得：
奥斯蒂剑鱼
水肺
璃化脊鳎
独角米索鳎
韧铠灵鲷

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.name: Benign Infested Tumor
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.description:
The Infestation infects all fish on Deimos, even those that do not show any external mutations.

Source: Cut from all Cambion Drift fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos).
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.descriptionEn:
The Infestation infects all fish on Deimos, even those that do not show any external mutations.

Source: Cut from all Cambion Drift fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos).
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.descriptionZh:
异变感染体感染了火卫二上的所有鱼类，连那些看起来没有任何变异的鱼也感染了。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从魔胎之境鱼类中切割获取。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.name: Pustulent Cognitive Nodule
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.description:
The Infestation provokes the growth of multiple, seemingly redundant brain-like clusters, whose function may be linked to hivemind activity. 

Source: Cut from Aquapulmo and Cryptosuctus fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Aquapulmo in Cambion Drift surface hotspots during Vome, and Cryptosuctus on the Cambion Drift surface during Fass. Also drops from Requiem Obelisks and Rolizor Infested Cysts in the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.descriptionEn:
The Infestation provokes the growth of multiple, seemingly redundant brain-like clusters, whose function may be linked to hivemind activity. 

Source: Cut from Aquapulmo and Cryptosuctus fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Aquapulmo in Cambion Drift surface hotspots during Vome, and Cryptosuctus on the Cambion Drift surface during Fass. Also drops from Requiem Obelisks and Rolizor Infested Cysts in the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.descriptionZh:
感染导致了多个看似多余，且类似大脑的簇状物的生长，其功能可能与巢群活动有关。 

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从水肺和墓沼隐龙中切割获取。 可在'秩序'期间的魔胎之境地面鱼点中捕捉水肺、在'混乱'期间的魔胎之境地面上捕捉墓沼隐龙。此外它还会从魔胎之境的安魂方尖碑和偌利佐尔感染包囊掉落。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.name: Dendrite Blastoma
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.description:
Elements of other lifeforms are detectable in Infested body parts, such as this apparently parasitic clump of land-dwelling animal tissue.

Source: Cut from Vitreospina and Barbisteo fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch both Vitreospina and Barbisteo in Cambion Drift caves during Vome and Fass. Also drops from Spitia Infested Cysts in the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.descriptionEn:
Elements of other lifeforms are detectable in Infested body parts, such as this apparently parasitic clump of land-dwelling animal tissue.

Source: Cut from Vitreospina and Barbisteo fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch both Vitreospina and Barbisteo in Cambion Drift caves during Vome and Fass. Also drops from Spitia Infested Cysts in the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.descriptionZh:
在 Infested 的身体部位中可以检测到其他生命形态的组成元素，例如这种明显属于陆地动物的寄生组织。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从璃化脊鳎和倒刺蒂鳌中切割获取。 可在'秩序'和'混乱'期间的魔胎之境洞穴中捕捉璃化脊鳎和倒刺蒂鳌。此外它还会从魔胎之境的斯蒂亚感染包囊掉落。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.name: Saturated Muscle Mass
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.description:
Environmental contamination is co-responsible for mutations, alongside Infested cellular alteration.

Source: Cut from Ostimyr and Kymaeros fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Ostimyr in Cambion Drift surface hotspots during Fass, and Kymaeros on the Cambion Drift surface during Fass and Vome. Also drops from Infested Cysts in the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.descriptionEn:
Environmental contamination is co-responsible for mutations, alongside Infested cellular alteration.

Source: Cut from Ostimyr and Kymaeros fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Ostimyr in Cambion Drift surface hotspots during Fass, and Kymaeros on the Cambion Drift surface during Fass and Vome. Also drops from Infested Cysts in the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.descriptionZh:
环境污染与 Infested 细胞变化，这两个都是引起突变的原因。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从奥斯蒂剑鱼和高额异鳍中切割获取。 可在'混乱'期间的魔胎之境地面鱼点中捕捉奥斯蒂剑鱼、在'混乱'和'秩序'期间的魔胎之境地面捕捉高额异鳍。此外它还会从魔胎之境的感染包囊掉落。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.name: Waxen Sebum Deposit
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.description:
Remnants of creatures' original bodily fluids persist post-Infestation, often crystalized or congealed into entirely new compounds.

Source: Cut from Amniophysi fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Amniophysi in Cambion Drift caves during Vome and Fass.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.descriptionEn:
Remnants of creatures' original bodily fluids persist post-Infestation, often crystalized or congealed into entirely new compounds.

Source: Cut from Amniophysi fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Amniophysi in Cambion Drift caves during Vome and Fass.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.descriptionZh:
生物原有的体液残余物在感染后仍会存在，通常会结晶或凝结成全新的化合物。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从针刺长鳄中切割获取。 可在'混乱'和'秩序'期间的魔胎之境洞穴捕捉针刺长鳄。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.name: Sporulate Sac
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.description:
These pressurized repositories of Infested spores require careful extraction or explosive rupture and local contamination may occur.

Source: Cut from Glutinox fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Glutinox on the Cambion Drift surface during Vome.  Also drops from Requiem Obelisks and Infested Cysts in the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.descriptionEn:
These pressurized repositories of Infested spores require careful extraction or explosive rupture and local contamination may occur.

Source: Cut from Glutinox fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Glutinox on the Cambion Drift surface during Vome.  Also drops from Requiem Obelisks and Infested Cysts in the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.descriptionZh:
这些存有感染孢子的加压储存囊需要被小心提取，否则就会炸裂并且可能造成局部污染。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从狍鸮胶蛳中切割获取。可在'秩序'期间的魔胎之境地面中捕捉狍鸮胶蛳。此外它还会从魔胎之境的安魂方尖碑和感染包囊掉落。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.name: Ocular Stem-Root
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.description:
The organs that once served as eyes, prior to Infestation, are still replete with useful components.

Source: Cut from Flagellocanth fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Flagellocanth in Cambion Drift surface hotspots using Processed Fass Residue during Fass and Vome. Also drops from Isolation Vault Bounties in the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.descriptionEn:
The organs that once served as eyes, prior to Infestation, are still replete with useful components.

Source: Cut from Flagellocanth fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Flagellocanth in Cambion Drift surface hotspots using Processed Fass Residue during Fass and Vome. Also drops from Isolation Vault Bounties in the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.descriptionZh:
这件在感染前曾经作为眼睛的器官仍包含有用的成分。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从须腔棘鱼中切割获取。 可在'秩序'和'混乱'期间的魔胎之境地面鱼点中使用处理过的'混乱'残留物捕捉须腔棘鱼。此外它还会从魔胎之境的隔离库赏金掉落。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.name: Parasitic Tethermaw
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.description:
Used to latch on to other life forms for feeding purposes, and to inject them with anticoagulants and sporelets.

Source: Cut from Lobotriscid fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Lobotriscid on the Cambion Drift surface during Vome.  Also drops from Isolation Vault Bounties in the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.descriptionEn:
Used to latch on to other life forms for feeding purposes, and to inject them with anticoagulants and sporelets.

Source: Cut from Lobotriscid fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Lobotriscid on the Cambion Drift surface during Vome.  Also drops from Isolation Vault Bounties in the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.descriptionZh:
用于附在其他生命体上以供养分，并把抗凝剂和孢子注入其中。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从额叶鲤中切割获取。 可在'秩序'期间的魔胎之境地面中捕捉额叶鲤。此外它还会从魔胎之境的隔离库赏金掉落。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.name: Biotic Filter
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.description:
Sifting the glutinous Exocrine is an essential part of the survival process, and a reminder of the creature's original function.

Source: Cut from Aquapulmo and Duroid fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Aquapulmo in Cambion Drift surface hotspots during Vome, and Duroid in Cambion Drift cave hotspots during Fass and Vome. Also drops from Requiem Obelisks and Auroron Entrati Caskets in the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.descriptionEn:
Sifting the glutinous Exocrine is an essential part of the survival process, and a reminder of the creature's original function.

Source: Cut from Aquapulmo and Duroid fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Aquapulmo in Cambion Drift surface hotspots during Vome, and Duroid in Cambion Drift cave hotspots during Fass and Vome. Also drops from Requiem Obelisks and Auroron Entrati Caskets in the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.descriptionZh:
筛分粘性的外分泌物是生存过程中必不可少的一部分，也是对生物原有功能的一种提醒。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从水肺和韧铠灵鲷中切割获取。 可在'秩序'期间的魔胎之境地面鱼点中捕捉水肺，在'混乱'和'秩序'期间的魔胎之境洞穴鱼点中捕捉韧铠灵鲷。此外它还会从魔胎之境的安魂方尖碑和幻金英择谛罐掉落。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.name: Spinal Core Section
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.description:
Many delicate and complex nerve fibers are housed in the jointed vertebrae, which are one of the creature's most resilient parts. Found from Vitreospina fish known to eke out a primitive existence in cave systems.

Source: Cut from Vitreospina and Chondricord fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Vitreospina in Cambion Drift caves during Fass and Vome, and Chondricord in Cambion Drift cave hotspots during Fass and Vome. Also drops from Isolation Vault Bounties and Sagiant Entrati Caskets in the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.descriptionEn:
Many delicate and complex nerve fibers are housed in the jointed vertebrae, which are one of the creature's most resilient parts. Found from Vitreospina fish known to eke out a primitive existence in cave systems.

Source: Cut from Vitreospina and Chondricord fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Vitreospina in Cambion Drift caves during Fass and Vome, and Chondricord in Cambion Drift cave hotspots during Fass and Vome. Also drops from Isolation Vault Bounties and Sagiant Entrati Caskets in the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.descriptionZh:
许多精巧而复杂的神经纤维被安置在有关节的脊椎骨中，这地方是生物最坚韧的部分之一。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从璃化脊鳎和骨锥琼鲷中切割获取。 可在'混乱'和'秩序'期间的魔胎之境洞穴中捕捉璃化脊鳎，在'混乱'和'秩序'期间的魔胎之境洞穴鱼点中捕捉骨锥琼鲷。此外它还会从魔胎之境的隔离库赏金和智者英择谛罐掉落。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.name: Cranial Foremount
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.description:
Beneath the membranous protein layers can be found a secondary 'skull'; flexible, tough and highly conductive.

Source: Cut from Myxostomata fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Myxostomata in Cambion Drift cave hotspots using Processed Vome Residue during Vome. Also drops from Requiem Obelisks in the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.descriptionEn:
Beneath the membranous protein layers can be found a secondary 'skull'; flexible, tough and highly conductive.

Source: Cut from Myxostomata fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Myxostomata in Cambion Drift cave hotspots using Processed Vome Residue during Vome. Also drops from Requiem Obelisks in the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Deimos/FishParts.descriptionZh:
在膜状蛋白层的下面，可以发现一个具有弹性、坚韧、且有着高导电性的次要'颅骨'。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'从独角米索鳎中切割获取。 可在'秩序'期间的魔胎之境洞穴鱼点中使用处理过的'秩序'残留物捕捉独角米索鳎。此外它还会从魔胎之境的安魂方尖碑掉落。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/FishPart.name: Charc Electroplax
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/FishPart.description:
Harvested by the Ostron as a catalyst used in their synthetics.

Source: Cut from Charc Eels via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Charc Eels in the Plains of Eidolon lake at any time of day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/FishPart.descriptionEn:
Harvested by the Ostron as a catalyst used in their synthetics.

Source: Cut from Charc Eels via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Charc Eels in the Plains of Eidolon lake at any time of day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/FishPart.descriptionZh:
被 Ostron 收割来作为合成反应的催化剂。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从查克鳗中切割获取。在任何时候的夜灵平野湖泊中捕捉查克鳗。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/FishPart.name: Goopolla Spleen
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/FishPart.description:
Used in Ostron remedies to purify toxins.

Source: Cut from Goopolla fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Goopolla in the Plains of Eidolon ocean at any time of day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/FishPart.descriptionEn:
Used in Ostron remedies to purify toxins.

Source: Cut from Goopolla fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Goopolla in the Plains of Eidolon ocean at any time of day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/FishPart.descriptionZh:
在 Ostron 中的偏方被用来净化毒素。

经过切割打磨，已至臻完美。

金星上福尔图娜的烟指出售的蓝图。

Properly mixed, these will destabilize Fomorian Reactors much faster than their Stable counterparts. This volatile item cannot be simultaneously equipped with Beta Corruptors. Recommended for Tenno operating as a team.

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/AntiSerumIn.name: Zealot Derelict Code

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ApartmentPe.name: Vista Suite Key

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ArgonCrysta.name: Argon Crystal

A Void based radioactive resource that decays every day it is out of the Void.

A Void based radioactive resource that decays every day it is out of the Void.

Various electronic components.

各类电子元器件。

A reagent commonly used to produce highly combustible fuel.

Autonomy processor for Robotics. A Corpus design.

Autonomy processor for Robotics. A Corpus design.

机器人的自主处理器。Corpus 设计。

Usually found in extreme sub-zero environments, Cryotic instantly freezes anything it contacts.

Location: Excavation Missions on Venus, Earth, Phobos, Europa, and Neptune

Usually found in extreme sub-zero environments, Cryotic instantly freezes anything it contacts.

Location: Excavation Missions on Venus, Earth, Phobos, Europa, and Neptune

通常在零度以下的极端环境中可以找到，永冻晶矿可以立即冰冻任何与它接触的东西。

获取地点：金星，地球，火卫一，欧罗巴和海王星上的挖掘任务

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DagathAbyss.name: Vainthorn
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DagathAbyss.description:
The rare thorn of an extinct rose, and a vital component in Orokin Defixios and other technology. Last seen near the Abyssal Zone.

Location: Abyssal Zone on Ceres (requires Abyssal Beacons to access)
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DagathAbyss.descriptionEn:
The rare thorn of an extinct rose, and a vital component in Orokin Defixios and other technology. Last seen near the Abyssal Zone.

Location: Abyssal Zone on Ceres (requires Abyssal Beacons to access)
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DagathAbyss.descriptionZh:
一种绝迹玫瑰的稀有刺，是奥罗金咒言板及其它技术中的关键组件。最后一次被看到是在深渊区域。

获取地点：谷神星深渊区域（需要深渊信标才能进入）

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DataFragmen.name: Tethra Data Fragments
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DataFragmen.description: Intercepted encrypted fragment of Grineer communications.

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DistillPoin.name: Vosfor
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DistillPoin.description: Loid uses devices in Albrecht's Laboratory to reduce Arcanes to Vosfor, a potent powder for alchemical processes. Speak to Loid in the Sanctum Anatomica on Deimos to trade Vosfor for Arcanes he has stored in the laboratory.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DistillPoin.descriptionEn: Loid uses devices in Albrecht's Laboratory to reduce Arcanes to Vosfor, a potent powder for alchemical processes. Speak to Loid in the Sanctum Anatomica on Deimos to trade Vosfor for Arcanes he has stored in the laboratory.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DistillPoin.descriptionZh: 洛德使用阿尔布雷希特实验室中的装置将赋能分解成荧尘，这是一种用于转换的强效粉末。在火卫二的解剖圣所与洛德对话，用荧尘交换他存放在实验室中的赋能。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Eidolonium.name: Breath of the Eidolon
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Eidolonium.description:
A gas found solely on the Plains of Eidolon, refined to its purest form. 

Location: Plains of Eidolon Bounties on Earth
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Eidolonium.descriptionEn:
A gas found solely on the Plains of Eidolon, refined to its purest form. 

Location: Plains of Eidolon Bounties on Earth

一种只能在夜灵平野上找到的气体，已被精炼到了最纯粹的状态。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Elitium.name: Vitus Essence

Awarded by the Arbiters of Hexis to the few Tenno capable of surviving Arbitration.

Location: Arbitration Missions

由均衡仲裁者授予少数能从仲裁中幸存的 Tenno。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Fissureum.name: Diluted Thermia
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Fissureum.description:
A magma like liquid that is diluted with coolant during the extraction process. Thermia can be found fracturing the surface of the Orb Vallis during thermal flare-ups. Could this be the key to weakening the Exploiter Orb's defenses?

Location: Thermia Fractures event in the Orb Vallis on Venus
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Fissureum.descriptionEn:
A magma like liquid that is diluted with coolant during the extraction process. Thermia can be found fracturing the surface of the Orb Vallis during thermal flare-ups. Could this be the key to weakening the Exploiter Orb's defenses?

Location: Thermia Fractures event in the Orb Vallis on Venus
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Fissureum.descriptionZh:
在萃取过程中能被冷却液稀释的液态岩浆。在热爆过程中，热美亚会出现在奥布山谷表面，并导致热美亚裂缝的产生。或许它就是瓦解剥削者圆蛛防御机制的关键？

获取地点：奥布山谷（金星）上的热美亚裂缝活动

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Gallium.name: Gallium
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Gallium.description:
Soft metal used in microelectronics and energy weapons.

Location: Mars and Uranus
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Gallium.descriptionEn:
Soft metal used in microelectronics and energy weapons.

Location: Mars and Uranus
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Gallium.descriptionZh:
用于微电子和能量武器的软金属。

获取地点：火星和天王星

These coordinates can be used to track Mutalist Alad V.

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Kuva.name: Kuva
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Kuva.description:
Kuva is an exceedingly rare red fluid coveted by the Grineer Queens. It can be obtained in Kuva Missions, and is used to Cycle Rivens or build rare blueprints.

Location: Kuva Siphon Missions and Taveuni (Kuva Fortress)
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Kuva.descriptionEn:
Kuva is an exceedingly rare red fluid coveted by the Grineer Queens. It can be obtained in Kuva Missions, and is used to Cycle Rivens or build rare blueprints.

Location: Kuva Siphon Missions and Taveuni (Kuva Fortress)
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Kuva.descriptionZh:
赤毒是 Grineer 女皇梦寐以求的一种非常罕见的红色液体。它可以从赤毒任务中获得，用来循环裂罅 Mod 或者制造稀有蓝图。

获取地点：赤毒虹吸任务、Taveuni（赤毒要塞）

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MemoryCrypt.name: Somatic Fibers
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MemoryCrypt.description:
Neural fibers sampled from an early Warframe prototype and preserved in a stabilized cerebral fluid.

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MemoryCrypt.descriptionEn:
Neural fibers sampled from an early Warframe prototype and preserved in a stabilized cerebral fluid.

Location: Demolishers on Apollo (Lua), and Conjunction Survival Missions (Lua)
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MemoryCrypt.descriptionZh:
从早期战甲原型采样并保存在一种稳定的脑液中的神经纤维。

获取地点：Apollo（月球）上的爆破型敌人、联结生存任务（月球）。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MirageCode.name: Orokin Cipher
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MirageCode.description:
This device is used to bypass Orokin encryptions.

Location: Orokin Derelict Vaults on Deimos once opened with a Dragon Key
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MirageCode.descriptionEn:
This device is used to bypass Orokin encryptions.

Location: Orokin Derelict Vaults on Deimos once opened with a Dragon Key
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MirageCode.descriptionZh:
这一装置可用来破解奥罗金的加密。

获取地点：通过龙钥开启过的奥罗金遗迹宝库（火卫二）

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Morphic.name: Morphics
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Morphic.description:
An amorphous solid. Possibly Orokin technology.

Location: Mercury, Mars, Phobos, Europa, and Pluto
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Morphic.descriptionEn:
An amorphous solid. Possibly Orokin technology.

Location: Mercury, Mars, Phobos, Europa, and Pluto

非晶态的固体。可能是奥罗金技术。

获取地点：水星，火星，火卫一，欧罗巴和冥王星

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Nanospores.name: Nano Spores

Fibrous technocyte tumour. Handle Infested tissue with caution.

Location: Saturn, Neptune, Eris, and Deimos
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Nanospores.descriptionEn:
Fibrous technocyte tumour. Handle Infested tissue with caution.

Location: Saturn, Neptune, Eris, and Deimos
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Nanospores.descriptionZh:
纤维状的科技细胞肿瘤。请谨慎处理感染者组织。

获取地点：土星，海王星，阋神星和火卫二

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/NarmerBount.name: Narmer Isoplast

An adaptive Sentient base component responsible for communication flows. Used extensively in the Narmer invasion. A valuable commodity for both The Quills and Vox Solaris.

Location: Narmer Bounties in the Plains of Eidolon (Earth) and Orb Vallis (Venus)
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/NarmerBount.descriptionZh:
一种用于 Sentient 通讯流的适应性基本组件。在合一众入侵时被广泛使用。对夜羽和索拉里斯之声来说都是一种很有价值的商品。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）和奥布山谷（金星）中的合一众赏金任务

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/NavCode.name: Nav Coordinate
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/NavCode.description:

Coordinate used to locate lost ships.

Location: Dropped from Storage Containers

获取地点：可在储存容器中获得

Location: When a Balor Fomorian is threatening a Planet's Relay, enemies on that Planet will drop this resource

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OxiumAlloy.name: Oxium

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RivenFragme.name: Riven Sliver
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RivenFragme.description:
A fragment of a sundered Riven. It is known that, with enough slivers, Palladino is capable of reforging a complete Riven. Find her in the Iron Wake (Earth) after completing The Chains of Harrow quest.

Location: Eximus units and Requiem Relics
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RivenFragme.descriptionEn:

Location: Eximus units and Requiem Relics
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RivenFragme.descriptionZh:

获取地点：卓越者单位、安魂遗物

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RivenSplice.name: Riven Splicer
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RivenSplice.description:

Obtained by completing The Icebind on Yuvan Peak.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RivenSplice.descriptionZh: 可以在 Mod 工作台使用，将裂罅属性从特殊可能性池中拼接成新的属性。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SentientFra.descriptionZh:

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SpecterPart.name: Spectral Debris
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SpecterPart.description:

Location: Errant Specters in the Granum Void (Corpus Ship Tileset)

获取地点：格拉努虚空（Corpus 飞船场景）中的游荡魅影

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/StableCorru.name: Stable Corruptor
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/StableCorru.description: Injected into a Fomorian Reactor this corruptor will imbalance the fuels. Critically imbalanced reactors will eventually implode, destroy the ship. Slow but effective, recommended for Solo Tenno.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/StableCorru.descriptionEn: Injected into a Fomorian Reactor this corruptor will imbalance the fuels. Critically imbalanced reactors will eventually implode, destroy the ship. Slow but effective, recommended for Solo Tenno.

/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenA.name: TRAINING DEBT-BOND
/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenA.description:
The Taxmen call it an investment in our future, but loans to cover vocational and specialist training almost always cost more than you'll ever earn. Especially with the interest.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenA.descriptionEn:
The Taxmen call it an investment in our future, but loans to cover vocational and specialist training almost always cost more than you'll ever earn. Especially with the interest.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenA.descriptionZh:
税务官将其称为对我们未来的投资，但是用来支付职业和专业培训的贷款几乎超过你的收入。尤其还有利息。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenB.name: SHELTER DEBT-BOND
/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenB.description:

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).

/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenC.name: MEDICAL DEBT-BOND
/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenC.description:
To get work you need mods. Then you need more work to pay for the mods, so you get more mods. And here we are.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenC.descriptionEn:
To get work you need mods. Then you need more work to pay for the mods, so you get more mods. And here we are.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenC.descriptionZh:
要有更多工作，你需要改装。然后你需要更多的工作来支付改装，这样你才能得到更多的改装。所以我们现在才会这样。

可从奥布山谷（金星）赏金中获得、或从福尔图娜（金星）Ticker 处购得

/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenD.name: ADVANCES DEBT-BOND
/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenD.description:
Sometimes a rig jockey needs a helping hand, so they get an advance on the next pay. Massive interest rates almost guarantee they'll be paying that off forever.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenD.descriptionEn:
Sometimes a rig jockey needs a helping hand, so they get an advance on the next pay. Massive interest rates almost guarantee they'll be paying that off forever.

可从奥布山谷（金星）赏金中获得、或从福尔图娜（金星）Ticker 处购得

/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenE.name: FAMILIAL DEBT-BOND
/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenE.description:
Debts unpaid by one generation are passed to the next. Working to pay them off is seen as something to be proud of. What choice do they have?

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).

Debts unpaid by one generation are passed to the next. Working to pay them off is seen as something to be proud of. What choice do they have?
